alex: AM standup — quick heads up: AMS-east GPU queue spiked ~3x since 05:10 UTC. Prewarm pool at 92% and a couple of nodes hit 98%. Not seeing errors yet but tail latency is noisy. Anyone running heavy jobs?
maria: I'm on it. I see a canary rollout for the reranker yesterday but traffic capped at 10% — not sure that alone explains the spike.
sam: I merged that canary but it's rate-limited; will check other rollouts and model pins.
jia: quick check — onboarding batch jobs kicked off around 04:58 UTC, lots of tiny requests. Looking at this prom query: 
```promql
sum(rate(inference_requests_total{region="ams-east"}[5m])) by (job)
```
Gives a few noisy jobs in the last 10m.
ops-bot: INF-459 created by maria: AMS-east temporary prewarm bump request (4 GPUs, 30m).
maria: Scaling prewarm 4 -> 8 for 30m now (will monitor). If we still see pressure I'll open a formal quota ticket.
alex: If quota fails, fallback plan = enable spillover to us-west for long-gen routes. Sam, can you stand by to flip routing?
sam: Yep — I can toggle `routing/region_preference` to promote us-west as secondary. Will prep the change and a short rollback.
oncall-lucy: I'm watching dashboards and alerts. Happy to take paging if anything pops.
alex: Action items: maria scaling, sam preps routing flip, jia collects traces + sample requests. I'll reconvene in ~30m and post an update. :thumbsup:
